column2: [Log] [BetterContinents] Fine heights: heightmap-fine.png refines heightmap.png with 8 bits a pixel: ground in steps of 0.97 mm at Heightmap Amount 81 (heightmap.png alone: 24.7 cm), <size> of tiles, <n> bits a pixel. A Better Continents older than this one cannot read a world made with fine heights.
[Log] [BetterContinents] Compact Maps is on for this world: its heightmap has fine heights (heightmap-fine.png), which a world keeps as compressed tiles, and so it does its maps.

[Warning] [BetterContinents] fx/fine8/heightmap.png was made by a world export for Heightmap Amount 81 and Sea Level Adjustment 0, but this new world reads it at Heightmap Amount 81 and Sea Level Adjustment 0.5, so its land is not at the heights it was made for. The export's export.cfg has the settings it needs.
Compact Maps: the maps are held and saved as compressed tiles, each decoded when the world reads it
Fine heights: 8 bits a pixel on top of the heightmap's 16: ground in steps of 0.97 mm at Heightmap Amount 81 (the heightmap alone: 24.7 cm)
High terrain: the land can reach 16170 m, so the game's rules that hold a height are patched (what is inside a dungeon, the ground and the grass, altitude limits, the AI's tiles)
Heightmap made by a world export for Heightmap Amount 81, Sea Level Adjustment 0
Biome precision 0: the ground takes its biomes from the 4 corners of each 64 m terrain zone (vanilla)
